releases.title: 版本更新
content: 新增：代码块内未选中文字时按 Ctrl+X（macOS 按 Cmd+X）可直接剪切光标所在整行，并将整行内容写入剪贴板，不会留空行
优化：内容块操作菜单移除「新增」「副本」两个入口，新增「问问AI」：点击即把整个内容块文本发送到 AI 聊天，可直接围绕该块内容提问
新增：AI 侧栏新增「Agent」模式：选择后 AI 会读取、搜索当前文档并自动提出局部修改建议，每处修改都展示修改前后对比，可逐条或全部接受/拒绝；接受的修改进入编辑器撤销历史，也支持一键撤销本次任务的全部修改
新增：Agent 任务执行过程分阶段实时展示，包含每步操作的结果与耗时，结束后提供目标核对与模型思考内容，执行更透明
新增：编辑器支持块框选：按住鼠标拖拽即可框选多个内容块（列表按条目选取），可对所选块整体复制、剪切或删除，按 Esc 取消
新增：外部文件修改提醒：其他程序改动当前打开的文件时，编辑器顶部显示横幅，可选择重新加载磁盘最新内容或忽略本次改动
新增：AI 聊天回复的代码块新增「自动换行」开关，默认开启，关闭后长代码行横向滚动查看
优化：AI 聊天回复正在生成的段落实时渲染排版效果（含代码块），不再以纯文本等待写完
优化：AI 聊天发送消息后输入框立即清空，方便继续输入下一条；发送失败时自动恢复原草稿，内容不丢失
优化：AI 回复代码块复制时自动去除代码首尾的多余空行，横向滚动条样式与编辑器保持一致
优化：查找替换仅作用于当前文档，避免「搜索横跨所有标签页、全部替换却只替换当前文件」的范围不一致问题
优化：设置中获取过的模型列表按厂商本地缓存，AI 侧栏可直接复用，无需重复请求
修复：源码模式下切换文档后按 Ctrl+Z 会回退到上一个文档内容的问题
contentEn: With no selection inside a code block, Ctrl+X (Cmd+X on macOS) cuts the caret's whole line and writes it to the clipboard without leaving a blank line.
The block action menu removes Insert and Duplicate and adds Ask AI: clicking sends the entire block text to AI chat for questions about that block.

Added an Agent mode to the AI sidebar: it reads and searches the current document, proposes local edits with before and after comparisons, and lets you accept or reject each or all; accepted edits enter the editor undo history and the whole task can be undone.
Agent tasks show stages and per-step results with timings in real time, followed by goal verification and model reasoning for transparency.
Editor block selection: drag to select multiple blocks (lists select by item), copy, cut, or delete the selection, and press Esc to cancel.
External file change banner: when another program changes the open file, a banner appears to reload the latest content or ignore the change.
Code blocks in AI replies have a wrap toggle, on by default; turning it off enables horizontal scrolling for long lines.
AI replies render formatting (including code blocks) as paragraphs stream instead of waiting as plain text.
After sending an AI chat message the input clears immediately; failures restore the draft so nothing is lost.
Copying AI reply code blocks removes extra leading and trailing blank lines; the horizontal scrollbar matches the editor.
Find and replace applies only to the current document, fixing the inconsistency where search spanned all tabs but replace only affected one file.
Model lists fetched in settings are cached locally per provider and reused by the AI sidebar without repeated requests.
Fixed Ctrl+Z in source mode reverting to the previous document after switching tabs.

linux.requirements: 主流 64 位 Linux 发行版
